newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends near steady as cash market weakens.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends near steady as cash market weakens.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed nearly steady despite a weaker tone in the domestic and overseas cash markets including the benchmark Thai price, traders said.
"The market held up pretty well despite the softer cash market," a trader said.
Traders said there was steady commercial buying under the market.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 250 contracts, below the 406 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice closed unchanged to one cent per cwt lower, with January down one at $10.46.
